description: graph: pin and budget every Agent spawn, record each run in the ledger, prime a session that has an active contract.

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && [ -f .claude/work/current.json ] && { uv run --quiet --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" sdlc-graph prime 2>/dev/null || bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_prime.sh"; }; exit 0
